inlines.v: THREE, adjective [Latin tres.] 1. Two and one. I offer thee three things. 2 Samuel 24:12. 2. It is often used like other adjectives, without the noun to which it refers. Abishai--attained not to the first three 2 Samuel 23:9. 3. Proverbially, a small number. Away, thou three-inched fool. [I believe obsolete.]
